items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I believe Clarence Williams once told me that George Thomas was the first one he heard play that Boogie bass. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, I remember George Thomas piano player.

ctx.x: Glenn Miller. Now you take Martha Bobcats. Martha Bobcats is a feature of Bob. Bob Crosby. And Boogie Woogie. Pine Top Smith. Featured by Tommy Dawson. I have to play Boogie was out. He played it good too.

Did you ever hear George Thomas play any of that kind of blues? Somebody told me, I believe Clarence Williams once told me that George Thomas was the first one he heard play that Boogie bass. You remember George Thomas of course. Oh yeah, I remember George Thomas piano player. Yes, played in the district. I think he had made that New Orleans. New Orleans. New Orleans. New Orleans. New Orleans.
New Orleans hopscotch blues. New Orleans hopscotch blues. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
